summary:
Image source, Getty ImagesImage caption, Slegers initially joined Arsenal in 2023 as an assistant coach under Jonas Eidevall
Arsenal have parted company with head coach Renee Slegers by mutual consent after a d
content:
Image source, Getty ImagesImage caption, Slegers initially joined Arsenal in 2023 as an assistant coach under Jonas Eidevall Arsenal have parted company with head coach Renee Slegers by mutual consent after a disappointing start to the season.

Slegers, 37, was initially appointed on an interim basis in October 2024 before being handed the role permanently three months later.

The Dutchwoman led Arsenal to a second Women's Champions League title in May 2025 and the inaugural Fifa Women's Champions Cup in February 2026.

But she leaves with the team sixth in the Women's Super League after 11 matches - 12 points behind leaders Chelsea.

Assistant coach Aaron D'Antino has also left the club, with assistant Melissa Clarke-Reed placed in interim charge as they begin the search for a permanent replacement.

title: Malagò insists Italy players pushed for Mancini’s return
summary: MILAN - NOVEMBER 12: Roberto Mancini, Head Coach of Italy, gestures during the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between Italy and France at San Siro Stadium on November 12, 2026 in Milan. (Photo by
content:
MILAN - NOVEMBER 12: Roberto Mancini, Head Coach of Italy, gestures during the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between Italy and France at San Siro Stadium on November 12, 2026 in Milan.

(Photo by Mattia Ozbot/Getty Images) Giovanni Malagò says Italy’s players were behind his decision to bring Roberto Mancini back as coach, and believes the Azzurri can rebuild around their young talent.

According to La Gazzetta dello Sport, the FIGC commissioner and presidential candidate was speaking at a debate organised by La Stampa at the MAUTO museum in Turin.

Legenda Włoch Fabio Cannavaro przyznaje, że uderzenie głową Zinedine'a Zidane'a w finale Pucharu Świata w 2006 roku pomogło mu zdobyć Złotą Piłkę: „Teraz jest warte trzy razy więcej; Nie widzę, jak obrońca może to ponownie wygrać.

Legendarny obrońca zdobył dziś Złotą Piłkę 20 lat temu.

Cannavaro, obecnie trener reprezentacji Uzbekistanu, pozostaje ostatnim obrońcą i ostatnim włoskim zawodnikiem, który zdobył tę upragnioną nagrodę.

"Teraz jest warte trzy razy więcej.

Od tamtej pory żaden obrońca nie zdobył tego tytułu i nie widzę, jak mogłoby się to powtórzyć" - powiedział Gazzetta.

title: Ten-man Bournemouth come from behind to beat Celta at Balaídos and top Europa League
summary:
La Liga
						
						Ten-man Bournemouth come from behind to beat Celta at Balaídos and top Europa League
						
							By Football España Editor - 27 November 2026, 7:18
content:
La Liga Ten-man Bournemouth come from behind to beat Celta at Balaídos and top Europa League By Football España Editor - 27 November 2026, 7:18 Celta Vigo lost at home to Bournemouth even though the visitors played most of the game a man down.

The defeat extends a difficult run for Claudio Giráldez's side, while the visitors moved to the top of the Europa League table.

Bournemouth came from behind to beat Celta Vigo 1-2 at the Municipal de Balaídos on Thursday 26 November 2026.

With Javier Rueda García providing the assist for Aspas, Celta went into the break 1-0 up.

The game turned soon after the restart.
